# Process Machine Learning Events {#_07089eec-9160-4897-8498-c5f051948e6d .reference}

Form ID: \(ML501000\)

You use this form to view the `ui/menu/node` system events. The system uses these events to rearrange each user’s menu items in Acumatica ERP based on the following data:

-   Search queries the user has entered in the Search box
-   Links the user has clicked in the search results

This is a service form, so it isn’t displayed in the search results. You can open it only by entering the URL that contains its form ID.

**Important:** The events are generated by the *Process Machine Learning Events* automation schedule. We recommend not stopping or removing this schedule.

## Form Toolbar { .section}

The form toolbar includes the buttons described below.

|Button|Description|
|------|-----------|
|**Process All**|Processes all events listed in the table.

 By default, the events run automatically. The system removes them 90 days after they are created.

|

## Table with Events {#2 .section}

This table lists the machine learning events.

The table toolbar has only standard buttons.

|Column|Description|
|------|-----------|
|**Selected**|A check box that you select to indicate that the event should be processed.|
|**Event Type**|The type and the name of the event.|
|**Number of Events**|The number of occurrences of the event in the system.|
|**Last Triggered**|The date when the event was last triggered.|
